facts.text: Four Corners grew from isolated rural hamlets into a connected suburban enclave after World War II, thanks to the Capital Beltway and nearby transit.
The Burnt Mills Dam, built in the 1930s on the Northwest Branch, created a reservoir that still shapes local watershed management.
Woodmoor Shopping Center opened in 1939 as one of Montgomery County’s first neighborhood malls, originally housing a supermarket and drugstore.
Four Corners is bounded by Dennis Avenue to the northwest, the Northwest Branch Trail to the northeast, and Interstate 495 to the south.
The Polychrome Historic District, a national historic district in Four Corners, showcases five houses built by John Joseph Earley in 1934‑35.
North Four Corners Park, acquired in the mid‑1940s, expanded to 14 acres by 1998 and once hosted temporary military homes during World War II.
